title: Points
unbindConfirm: Unbind point {id}? The sensor stays and can be bound again.
calNotAsserted: calibration status not reported by the module
unbindBody: The point stops being metered and leaves the overview. Deleting the point erases its stored history for good — download it first in History (CSV) if you need it. The sensor channel stays and can be used for a new point.
noFreeChannels: No free channels. To add a point, connect another rbAmp module or unbind a point you don’t need.
basicNote: BASIC line: counts consumption only (doesn't see export); the module firmware isn't updated through the hub.
currentOnlyNote: Current-only module: for current monitoring, not energy metering — no kWh or cost shown for it.
uncalibrated: The module isn't calibrated: the sensor model can't be chosen.
inputGroupTitle: Measure the input on all three phases of {model}?
inputGroupBody: The input will measure all three phases of this module after a restart. Its history stays.
inputGroupDone: The hub will measure the input on all three phases after a restart.
inputGroupUpdate: Three-phase input from one {model}: update the hub to 1.1.2.
busStalled: The module bus is stuck — no readings for {s} s. Check the module connections (a module wired without power blocks the bus), then restart the hub.
busLineLow: A module bus line is held low — no module can be read. A module may be without power, set to another mode, or wired wrong: check the module connections.
metering_grouped: Input: one point for all three phases (phases netted)
meteringGroupedHint: Like a meter that nets the phases: export on one phase offsets import on another.
meteringSplitHint: Like a meter that counts each phase: every phase has its own import and export, nothing is offset.
meteringSingleHint: Only L1 counts toward the input; L2 and L3 of this module aren’t in it.
perPhaseBody: Each phase becomes its own input point with its own import and export, as on a meter that counts per phase. Export on one phase is no longer offset by import on another. The input point keeps its history and takes L1; L2 and L3 start from zero. Applies after a restart.
perPhasePartial: Not every phase got its point: {why}. Press «One point per phase» again to retry.
nettedTitle: Meter the input as one point?
nettedBody: The input measures all three phases as one point, phases netted, as on a meter that nets them. Its history stays. Applies after a restart.
nettedBodyLegs: The input measures all three phases as one point again, phases netted. The points {points} are deleted and their own history is erased; their totals move into the input, so the site’s totals stay. Applies after a restart.
meteringDone: Saved. The hub meters the input this way after a restart.
